component.name: Nexis
component.summary: System optimizer and monitor for Linux and macOS

description.p: Nexis is a free, open-source system optimizer and monitoring tool for Linux and macOS. It provides a real-time dashboard alongside targeted tools for cleaning, managing processes, services, startup applications, and more.

ul.li: Real-time dashboard with CPU, memory, disk, GPU, network, fan, and battery tiles
System Cleaner — scan and remove temporary files, package caches, and old logs
Process Manager with GPU% and VRAM columns, pinning, and threshold alerts
APT Repository Manager (Linux) and Homebrew integration (macOS)
Disk Tools including large/old-file scanner and TRIM scheduler
Listening-port audit with code-signing verification on macOS
Swappiness, CPU frequency, and turbo tuning (Linux)

description.p: Nexis is a fork of the discontinued Stacer project, independently maintained by S4 Solutions, LLC under the GPL-3.0-or-later licence. It is always free with no paid tiers, no telemetry, and no email walls.

screenshot.caption: Process Manager with GPU and VRAM columns

ul.li: Fixed: process page search now correctly matches substrings (case-insensitive)
Fixed: app version number in title and Settings now always matches the installed package
Fixed: APT Repository Manager no longer falsely flags Release-only repos as unreachable
